commands.command: if [ -f build.py ]; then sed -n '1,360p' build.py; fi
git status --short && git diff -- build.py tests/test_s1.py

python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    root = Path(directory)
    (root / 'content').mkdir()
    (root / 'content' / 'early.md').write_text(
        'written: 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z\ntype: short\n\nearly', encoding='utf-8'
    )
    (root / 'content' / 'late.md').write_text(
        'written: 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z\ntype: short\n\nlate', encoding='utf-8'
    )
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, './build.py'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, (result.returncode, result.stderr)
    feed = (root / 'docs' / 'index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert feed.index('p/late.html') < feed.index('p/early.html')
    print('edge-year build: OK')
PY
